key_findings: **7-class linear inheritance chain CONFIRMED**: CharaBase < ActorBase < LuaControl < LuaObject < LgeBase < LgeCommonMemoryAllocator < LgeBasicMemoryAllocator. All TDs already cataloged (BCS-Y-1721/1496/1677/1476/1477/1478/1479). The hypothesis from BCS-Y-1723 is now PROVEN via direct BCD enumeration.

**Architectural insight - mdisp=4 split-point at LgeBase**: BCDs for CharaBase (depth 0) through LuaObject (depth 3) have mdisp=0 (primary single inheritance, all sharing offset +0). BCDs for LgeBase (depth 4) through LgeBasicMemoryAllocator (depth 6) have mdisp=4 - they form a SECONDARY subobject at offset +4 within the most-derived (CharaBase) class. Interpretation: LuaObject has its own vftable at +0 with 4 bytes of own state before its base subobject; LgeBase is placed at +4 as the secondary base (NON-PRIMARY single inheritance). The CHD attributes=0x00 (no MI flag) is consistent because each class has only ONE direct base - the offset displacement comes from the layout decision at LuaObject, not from MI at the CharaBase or any other level.

**The Lge memory-allocator chain is CharaBase-inherited**: the prior memory.md note about 'Lge memory-allocator chain' is now confirmed to be a transitive base hierarchy inherited by CharaBase (via LuaObject). The 3 Lge classes (LgeBase, LgeCommonMemoryAllocator, LgeBasicMemoryAllocator) provide CharaBase with its memory-allocation interface. This same chain is inherited by ALL classes that derive from LuaObject - which includes the full Application::Lua::Script::Client::Control::* tree (CharaBase + PlayerBase + NpcBase + MyPlayer + 11 LTC/LGTC classes + 30+ more from FUN_0075F9B0 mass registry).

**BCA depth-first walk structure verified**: each BCD's numContainedBases field correctly enumerates the descendants in the chain: CharaBase says '6 contained' (the 6 below), ActorBase says '5 contained', LuaControl says '4 contained', LuaObject says '3 contained', LgeBase says '2 contained', LgeCommonMemoryAllocator says '1 contained', LgeBasicMemoryAllocator says '0 contained' (leaf). Standard MSVC BCA depth-first traversal.

**BCD attributes=0x40 for all 7 BCDs**: bit 0x40 = HASPCHD (the BCD has an associated CHD pointer at offset +0x18). Standard MSVC convention for BCDs whose subordinate class has its own RTTI structures. No AMBIGUOUS (0x02) or VIRTUAL (0x10) bits set - confirms non-virtual non-ambiguous inheritance throughout the chain.
